description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of child nodes (tree width) and the accuracy@1 (%) for two different models: GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The x-axis, labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)," ranges from 1 to 7, with data points plotted at intervals of 2 (1, 3, 5, 7). The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)," is scaled from 15 to 35, with major tick marks at 5% intervals. The GPT-4o model, represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, shows an increasing trend in accuracy from 24.4% at a tree width of 1 to a peak of 34.4% at a tree width of 5, followed by a decline to 31.1% at a tree width of 7. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet model, represented by a dashed light blue line with circular markers, exhibits a decreasing trend, starting at 26.7% at a tree width of 1, peaking at 27.8% at a tree width of 3, and then declining to 20.0% at a tree width of 7. The two lines intersect between a tree width of 1 and 3, where the GPT-4o model's accuracy surpasses that of the Claude-3.5-Sonnet model.
